page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.14xlarge is a dedicated virtual server belonging to the High Clock Speed instance family, running on the KVM hypervisor. Built upon x86_64 architecture, the machine is driven by an Intel Xeon 6149 processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. Compute resources are strictly isolated, providing 56 dedicated virtual CPU cores designed for sustained execution without multi-tenant thread contention.

System memory totals 160.0 GB, which calculates to an allocation of 2.86 GB of RAM per virtual core. Local storage is not provisioned with this instance, requiring deployments to attach external network block storage for persistent file systems and operating system data. The platform provides a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. No hardware GPU accelerators are included, and the instance is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware configuration trades local disk throughput and extreme memory density for dedicated high-frequency CPU cores. This architecture yields strong cost efficiency for compute-dominant tasks where massive RAM capacities are unnecessary. The instance is suited for compute-intensive enterprise applications, batch data processing, continuous integration build jobs, and backend application hosting requiring consistent processor cycles.
